identity.addresses: Oudemanhuispoort 2 (H, 1), 3 (H, 1), 4 and Oudezijds Achterburgwal 217 (BAG verblijfsobjecten); the lane brief's 'Kloveniersburgwal 72 range' is wrong as an address: Kloveniersburgwal 68-72 (rijksmonumenten) are canal houses on this pand's Kloveniersburgwal front, but they have no BAG address of their own
identity.what: north and west wings of the Oude Mannen- en Vrouwengasthuis carre (1601, rebuilt 1754-57 by city architect G.F. Maybaum, University of Amsterdam since 1880), between the Kloveniersburgwal, Rusland, the Oudezijds Achterburgwal and the covered book-market passage, round an enclosed courtyard (the BAG holes); on the Kloveniersburgwal the 1927 wing by P.L. Marnette ('de schaats') and three canal houses
identity.notThis: the GASTHUIS APOTHEEK portal of the old recipe stands on the next building south of the passage's east gate (pand 0363100012177827); the row houses in the brief's Rusland crop are on the north side of Rusland
